title: Brutal Fight Breaks Out At A High School Graduation Party
description:
On June 12, 2022. Mass commotion breaks out at a high school graduation party, when officers arrived they noticed multiple people had been fighting each other for reasons unknown. Police apprehended 3 people, which included a mom and son combo due to their behavior.
